text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Shuka Sho. I took Yukino 
Bijin and headed for her hometown of 
Morioka.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Is it really alright? Going back to the 
village in a state like this...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If I look at everyone's faces... I might 
just burst into tears.
choice_data_list: It's all right to cry, you know.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still... once I clear my head, I might not 
even wanna go back to the academy.
choice_data_list:
If it comes to that, I'll do whatever it 
takes to convince them.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Because I love watching you run, you know.
Because I love watching you run, you know.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And safely arriving at the village where 
she was born and raised—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mmm~gh...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haaah~! That's village air for ya!
choice_data_list: Then shall we head over to Mifuyu's?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Mifuyu-chan's...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Could it be an ice skating rink!?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wooww...! It's been so long since I last 
got to see Mifuyu-chan skate!
choice_data_list:
I heard today's training is mainly jump 
practice.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, right! For the badge test...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If Mifuyu-chan doesn't pass her next test, 
she won't be able to compete in the big 
tournament.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've never really been all that 
good at jumping.
choice_data_list: So that's why you've been working so hard.

So that's why you've been putting in so 
much effort.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but Mifuyu-chan's always had 
top-notch expressive skills, dontcha know!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If we can jump, we're invincible, but even 
if we can't, it's still gonna be amazin'! 
Ehehe, I can't wait♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, along with Yukino Bijin, we 
decided to go see Mifuyu-san skating on 
the rink, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Swish...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...! Mifuyu-chan, you're jumping...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu glides smoothly across the rink, 
dancing lightly as if gravity doesn't 
exist. The ice chips carved out by the 
blades sparkle—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, when did they...? It's so 
beautiful...—

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
—Sorry to keep you waiting! And Yuki-chan, 
welcome back!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, Mifuyu-chan! Wait, never mind 
that!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That was amazin'! Your jump was super 
clean!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Ehh, that's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding. Now that I can jump, I 
just really wanted Yuki-chan to see me do 
it♪ So I went and begged Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe this is the same 
Mifuyu-chan from back then! When we were 
taking classes together, you used to cry 
out of frustration when you couldn't jump, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Since I left for Tokyo, Mifuyu-chan's 
worked crazy hard too, huh!"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I was in a totally desperate spot, 
after all~.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I think it was right around the time 
Yuki-chan was running in the Oaks. My 
coach told me to give up on my dream.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"They said, 'Honestly, she's not cut out 
for world championships. She has great 
expressiveness, so she'd be better off 
switching to ice shows right now'..."

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"I knew it deep down, too. Kids younger 
than me keep passing the tests and taking 
off toward the world stage."

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I can't join that circle. I can't become 
who I want to be, and I'm just not cut out 
to make my dreams come true.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu-chan...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
But you know, watching Yuki-chan run made 
me think, "I can't let myself get 
discouraged here!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Me?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Because Yuki-chan has always been 
the one I looked up to.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yuki-chan has been amazing ever since we 
were kids, and everyone expected great 
things from her. And now, she really is 
running in big races.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"She's already so close to her dream, 
right? Yet she's still gritting her teeth! 
She's working hard to go even further."

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
—Then there's no way I can give up. I want 
to be a best friend that the shining 
Yuki-chan can be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Wait, geez. Why do you look like you're 
gonna cry?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Because... I... I don't deserve to be told 
something like that...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I wanna run away. It hurts so 
bad. I just wanna give up on everything.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you've never run away, right? You 
always talk about having guts, and you 
kept working hard even when the coach 
pushed you to the brink.”

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I can tell because I've been watching you 
all along. Yuki-chan, well... you can be a 
bit timid sometimes, right?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Honest and cute, but not just that. 
Stronger than anyone. My cool best friend!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Yuki-chan. Because you're here 
for me... I can be someone who never gives 
up.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
It keeps me grounded, reminding me to be 
the person I want to be. So... thank you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah...! Mifuyu-chaaaan...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if everything she had held back had 
suddenly burst, Yukino Bijin's tears 
continued to overflow for a while after.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...*sniffle*.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, I'm okay now. ...I can't give 
up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I have to become a sparkling "City Girl." 
Just like Mifuyu-chan hasn't given up on 
her dream.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My best friend is giving it her all out 
there, so there's no way I can just stop 
thinking!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—I have to become the person I want to be. 
So I won't ever be swept along by anyone 
again... A strong, cool "City Girl."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, it's not just that...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...It made me really happy, y'know. Seeing 
Mifuyu-chan watch my race and feel 
inspired to do her best, too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Right now, what I wanna be is... Run in a 
way that lets me love myself, and then—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A "City Girl" who is truly and genuinely 
loved by everyone.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Though, that might be a bit of an 
exaggeration on my part!"
choice_data_list: Let's make that new dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“—We haven't decided on our next target 
race yet, have we?”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I have a favor to ask. I want to... spark 
a whole new boom, this time with my own 
power!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Isn't it just a coincidence that 
people were cheering for me up until now?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"It just so happened that Umamusume from 
the regional circuits were getting 
attention, and I just happened to fit the 
bill."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“But... up until now, I wasn't able to 
turn that into reality.”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Still! Take Oguri-san, for example—she 
wasn't an incredible legend right from the 
start, either."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I believe that by running and running... 
I've turned this hype into something real.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It might be presumptuous of me, but I 
wanna start from scratch and give it my 
all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
From here, I'm gonna train hard for the 
rest of the time, so next year... in the 
Senior Class, I can show you a whole new 
me!
choice_data_list:
Then shall we set our sights on the Osaka 
Hai?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's the first middle-distance GⅠ of the 
new year, and a stellar lineup of top 
contenders is expected. It's the perfect 
stage for a fresh start.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer. Do you think... I can do it?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"One more boom... and a huge one, just 
like Oguri-san's."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Can I really do it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin getting results on the Triple 
Tiara route was no fluke.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And she possesses the sheer grit to keep 
conveying her earnest feelings.
choice_data_list: Let's show them what you can really do!

Let's show them what you're truly capable 
of!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll show 'em the sheer grit and 
power of a true Morioka Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race was set: the 
Senior Year Osaka Hai!
